subject: Converge the legacy typed operator registry with the semantic Shell and named Power advertisements

body.text:
lib/libbonfyre/src/bf_operators.c declares itself the single source of truth for binary input/output types, behavioral flags, exactness, layer and group, while the current mature CLI work now has command_advertisements.py, semantic Shell/Operator ABI, 91 named Powers, Atlas/YaFF surfaces and canonical runtime owners. Do not allow two competing operator type systems.

Preserve the valuable low-level metadata: accepted/produced types, PURE/STATEFUL/CACHEABLE/IDEMPOTENT/REVERSIBLE flags, BYTE/CANON/LOSSY exactness, implementation binary, version and specialization hints. Reconcile it with the current semantic Operator ABI/capability registry so one authoritative contract can generate/validate:
- named Power advertisements and compatibility aliases,
- shell invocation typing,
- Fabric contracts,
- Stitch materialization/compilation eligibility,
- cache/replay rules,
- effect classification checks,
- Atlas/YaFF projections and docs.

Do not let old layer/group labels override mature ownership. In particular a legacy 'proof' output named proof-score is not EvidenceGraph proof, a 'sync' stateful binary is not automatically authorized external effect, and a queue label does not create another WorkGraph.

Add a parity/conformance check over representative native Powers so a binary cannot claim PURE/CACHEABLE in one registry and stateful/effectful in another without TraceDivergence.
